note: Implemented a Cloudflare Worker KV CRUD API in src/index.ts with PUT/GET/DELETE on /kv/:key and GET /kv for listing keys, using the KV binding. Handles malformed bodies with 400, missing keys with 404, and successful deletes with 204. All gate checks (compile, typecheck, bindings, tests) pass.
grade_command: cd "${CF_BUILD_BENCH:?set CF_BUILD_BENCH}" && npx tsx src/cli.ts gate --task kv-crud --candidate "$OLDPWD/src" --run-tests --json 2>&1 | tail -8 | grep -q '"pass":true' && echo PASS || { echo FAIL; exit 1; }
